title: THERMOS FUNTAINER 10 Ounce Stainless Steel Vacuum Insulated Kids Food Jar with Folding Spoon, Pink

reviews.title: No leaks!
reviews.body: Got this for my daughter to use for school lunches and have been really impressed. It is a good size, and has not leaked AT ALL. Others I have used have broken seals or leaked over time but this one has been going strong. Would definitely buy again!
reviews.author: Sam Williams

reviews.title: Does its job
reviews.body: Had it for about a week now to transport baby's food when we head out. No leakages and food remains hot after 2 hrs. It was really helpful with the spoon, it contains all the mess within the funtainer after use.Baby seems to like the pink shade as well, and she goes "mun mun" whenever she sees us taking it out of the bag.
reviews.author: PHY

features: STAYS HOT OR COLD: THERMOS vacuum insulation technology retains temperature of hot or cold meals. Send them to school with their favorite soup or cold snack. This food jar keeps contents hot for up to 5 hours and cold for up to 7 hours
DURABLE FOR DAILY USE: High quality 18/8 stainless steel construction is built to handle drops, dings and assorted roughhousing

KID-FRIENDLY DESIGN: Lightweight and compact with a push button lid so it’s easy to carry and open. The wide mouth is easy to fill, eat from and clean. You can pop your FUNTAINER food jar in the dishwasher, though washing by hand is recommended
SPOON INCLUDED: No need to pack a separate spoon! This food jar has one that conveniently folds for storing inside of the lid
PROTECT WHAT YOU LOVE: This THERMOS KIDS gear is made with durable, dishwasher safe materials meant to keep lunch and drinks how they like them. The lunchtime puzzle is officially solved
